Harborlight Candle Co.

Harborlight Candle Co. hand-pours soy candles in a small coastal workshop in Rockport, Maine. Every candle is poured in batches of two dozen, scented with essential oils rather than synthetic fragrance, and cured for two full weeks before it ships. We started the workshop in 2018 after years of making candles as gifts for friends and family.

We deliberately never built a sitemap.xml for this site -- it's a single page, updated rarely, and we'd rather keep the site simple than maintain a file that would only ever list one URL. Get in touch if you have questions about a specific scent.
